title: Armor SMP
description: Perfect twist for ur SMP, adds 4 custom armor pieces with special abilities / passives
body:
# ᴀʀᴍᴏʀ ꜱᴍᴘ
**A plugin that adds four legendary armor pieces, each with unique abilities, passive buffs, perfect for ur SMP!**

## Armor Pieces
**🔴 Blazing Chestplate :**
- Passive : Strength II (permanent while worn)
- Ability : Seismic Toss — Hold Shift for 3 seconds,On full charge, all nearby enemies (players + mobs) within 6 blocks are launched into the air.
  
**🟡 Inferno Leggings :**
- Passive : Fire Resistance (permanent while worn)
- Proc Ability : Swift Step — 30% chance on hitting a player to gain Speed III for 3 seconds

**🔵 Tidal Helmet**
- Passive : Resistance I (permanent while worn)
- Poseidon's Blessing : Dolphins Grace effect automatically applied when in water

**🟢 Gale Boots**
- Passive : Speed II (permanent while worn)
- Ability : Wind Dash — Press F (Swap Hands key) to launch yourself forward with a unique nature vine sound effect. 5s cooldown.
